confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from Koh Samui-specific sources that conflict on price and date (roughly 2025 to 2026), converted at about 34 THB per USD, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail is set between happy-hour listings and typical bar prices. Wine has no per-glass source and is inferred at about 1.7 times the beer anchor. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Samui tiers for July low season; they were not searched and were not checked against live listings. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate page snippets, and I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Koh Samui-specific sources, with beer and cocktail figures bounded by happy-hour listings and typical bar and restaurant reports. Wine is inferred from the beer anchor. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of Samui guesthouse, hostel and 3-star tiers, with no comparable-city basis.
